side_note: Positions are never entered by hand: they are recomputed from the structure, so inserting in the middle never means shifting anything manually.
canvas_aria: GRAFCET canvas. Arrow keys to navigate, {k} to insert, Delete to remove, Enter for properties.
ins_help: Click an element, or press an arrow key, to place the cursor.
sim_help: click a highlighted transition to fire it.
sim_force_init_hint: INIT forcing: puts the displayed GRAFCET back in its initial situation
sim_force_empty_hint: Empty forcing: deactivates every step of the displayed GRAFCET
sim_force_freeze_hint: Freeze forcing (star): freezes the displayed GRAFCET; press again to release it
sim_force_help: Shift + click a step: activate or deactivate it.
png_fail: PNG conversion failed: try the SVG image.
pdf_hint: In the print dialog, choose “Save as PDF”.
image_hint: Drawing of the chosen GRAFCETs (black on white, no interface elements): one SVG or PNG file per GRAFCET. The PDF gathers the chosen GRAFCETs, one per page, in the print dialog: choose “Save as PDF”.
scope_hint: Only the checked GRAFCETs are exported (native project, SFCEdit, PLCopen). Macro-steps refer to other GRAFCETs: keep them checked to preserve them.
desc_native: SFC Editor’s native format: the project re-imports without any loss.
desc_sfcedit: XML readable by SFCEdit (see the conversion warnings below).
desc_plcopen: PLCopen XML (TC6, SFC language) for automation tools.
desc_zip: The whole project: one file per GRAFCET in a ZIP archive.
desc_folder: Saves the whole project into a folder on your computer.
desc_svg: Vector drawing, black on white: one file per chosen GRAFCET.
desc_png: PNG image (×2): one file per chosen GRAFCET.
desc_pdf: The chosen GRAFCETs, one per page. Opens in the print dialog: choose “Save as PDF”.
desc_json: Technical preview of the active GRAFCET (to copy or debug).
desc_graph: Technical preview of the active GRAFCET’s derived graph.
desc_share: Publishes a copy of the project reachable through a temporary link.
preview_aria: Preview of the first chosen GRAFCET
nav_share_t: Share the project through a temporary link
share_unavailable: Link sharing is not available on this installation: no sharing server is configured.
act_none: No action: the step is a waiting step.
jump_hint: A jump ends the sequence. After a transition it points to a step; after a step it points to a transition.
key_move: move the cursor from element to element
key_insert: insert a step / a transition; with Shift, on the opposite side
no_issue_more: No other issue detected in this GRAFCET.
text_hint: Text equivalent of the diagram, navigable with the keyboard and screen readers.
copy_fail: Copy refused: select the text manually.
import_hint: Paste the JSON of a complete project (replaces the project) or of a single GRAFCET (adds it).
imp_items: A GRAFCET must contain an “items” array.
a_cannot_delete: Cannot delete here: the sequence would become inconsistent.
a_renumbered: Steps and transitions renumbered, Xn references updated.
chk_start_or: an OR divergence branch starts with a transition
chk_start_and: an AND divergence branch starts with a step
chk_min_branches: a link has at least 2 branches
v_dupnum: Step number {n} is used more than once.
v_act_label: Step {n}: an action has no label.
v_act_cond: Step {n}: a conditional action has no condition.
v_step_missing: Transition ({n}): step X{m} does not exist.
v_jump_broken: A jump has lost its target.
v_dead_end: {x} has no successor: the GRAFCET is not closed.
v_unreachable: {x} is unreachable from the initial step.
imp_format: This file is not a SFC Editor project.
share_hint: Publish a copy of the project on the sharing server: anyone with the link can open it. The share expires and can be deleted.
share_what: By publishing, you send a copy of this project to the sharing server:
share_what_1: anyone with the link can read the project (names, steps, receptivities, actions); there is no password;
share_what_2: the share is a frozen copy: changing your project afterwards does not change the link;
share_what_3: it expires automatically; you can delete it earlier from this device. Do not share personal data.
share_delete_hint: To delete this share before it expires, use “Delete” in the Export window, on this device.
share_published: Project shared. The link is displayed.
share_open_what: “{name}” ({n} GRAFCET) has been shared with you.
share_open_hint: Opening a copy replaces the current project; you can undo with Ctrl+Z.
share_opened: Copy of the shared project opened.
share_err_rate_limit: Too many recent shares: try again later.
share_err_too_large: The project is too large to share.
share_err_invalid: The document is not a valid project.
share_err_not_found: This share does not exist or has expired.
imp_sfcedit_root: This XML is not an SFCEdit export (expected a “project” element).
rep_unknown_tag: Element “{tag}” is not supported and was ignored.
rep_grafcet_type: Grafcet “{g}” has type “{type}”: imported as a normal GRAFCET.
rep_step_type: Steps of type “{type}” in “{g}” ({n}): {names} — imported as normal steps.
rep_step_name: Step name “{name}” in “{g}” is not numeric: a number was assigned.
rep_action_type: Action of type “{type}” in “{g}”: imported as a continuous action.
rep_cycle: “{g}”: circular structure or no starting point, sequences ignored.
rep_jump_target: “{g}”: jump to an empty sequence, ignored.
rep_jump_resolved: “{g}”: jump from a placeholder translated into direct jumps to the target step.
rep_conv_kind: “{g}”: divergence and convergence of different kinds (AND/OR).
rep_orphan_seq: “{g}”: sequence {n} is not connected to anything and was not imported.
rep_x_jump_mid: “{g}”: a jump targets the middle of a sequence; SFCEdit can only target a sequence start.
rep_x_timer: “{g}”: timers are written as plain text in conditions.
rep_x_actions: “{g}”: activation actions are kept in an attribute SFCEdit ignores.
rep_x_labels: Step names are kept in an attribute SFCEdit ignores.
v_num_bad: Step identifier “{n}” is invalid: letters, digits and _ only.
imp_zip_not_zip: This file is not a valid ZIP archive.
imp_zip_method: Compressed archive not supported (only SFC Editor archives are).
imp_zip_path: Archive rejected: file path not allowed.
imp_plcopen_root: This XML is not a PLCopen project (expected a “project” element).
imp_plcopen_nosfc: No POU with an SFC body in this PLCopen project.
rep_p_skip_pou: POU “{n}” skipped: its body is not SFC.
rep_p_ident: “{n}” (in “{g}”) is not a valid IEC identifier: it is not declared in the POU interface.
rep_p_cond_action: “{g}”: conditional actions are exported as an ST assignment (variable := condition).
rep_p_empty_cond: “{g}”: transition ({n}) has no receptivity; exported without a condition.
rep_p_edge: “{g}”: edges (↑ ↓) cannot be represented in the ST condition; the edge is omitted.
rep_p_jump_trans: “{g}”: a jump to a transition does not exist in PLCopen (jump not exported).
rep_p_qualifier: “{g}”: action qualifier “{q}” not supported, imported as a continuous action.
rep_p_inline_action: “{g}”: unrecognised action body, kept as text.
rep_p_cond_st: “{g}”: a condition contains ST code that is not a plain Boolean expression; please check.
rep_p_cond_graphic: “{g}”: graphical condition (FBD/LD) not supported, empty receptivity.
rep_p_conv_mixed: “{g}”: the branches of a divergence do not converge at the same point.
rep_p_implicit_div: “{g}”: several successors without an explicit divergence; only the first is kept.
rep_p_no_initial: “{g}”: no initial step declared; the first step without predecessor is used.
rep_p_orphan: “{g}”: elements not connected to the initial step were not imported.
profile_help_grafcet: GRAFCET as a specification language: common checks, plus exclusivity of OR divergences.
profile_help_sfc: SFC for a programmable controller: common checks, plus IEC-compatible jumps, edges and identifiers.
profile_help_plcopen: SFC intended for PLCopen XML export: SFC rules, plus the limits of the export.
v_or_exclusive: OR divergence: exclusivity of transitions ({a}) and ({b}) is not proven; both may fire together.
v_sfc_jump_trans: A jump to a transition does not exist in SFC: a jump targets a step.
v_sfc_edge: Transition ({n}): an edge (↑ ↓) is not a direct SFC condition; an edge detector is needed.
v_sfc_ident: Step {n}: “{v}” is not a valid IEC identifier (unaccented letters, digits and _).
v_plc_cond_action: Step {n}: the conditional action will be exported as an ST assignment.
cited_here: Cited by {n} element of this GRAFCET (highlighted). | Cited by {n} elements of this GRAFCET (highlighted).
cite_title: A receptivity or action in this GRAFCET cites step {n}
v_macro_expansion_missing: Macro-step {n}: the expansion no longer exists.
v_macro_cycle: Macro-step {n}: its expansion ends up containing it (recursion).
v_macro_shared: Macro-step {n}: its expansion is shared with another macro-step.
v_macro_actions: Macro-step {n}: a macro-step carries no actions; they are ignored.
v_expansion_entry: An expansion must have exactly one entry step (E); this GRAFCET has {n}.
v_expansion_exit: An expansion must have exactly one exit step (S); this GRAFCET has {n}.
rep_x_macro: “{g}”: SFCEdit has no macro-steps; they are exported as ordinary steps (the expansion stays a separate GRAFCET).
rep_p_macro: “{g}”: macro-steps are exported as ordinary steps (the expansion stays a separate POU).
v_event_no_edge: Step {n}: the event of an on-event action should contain an edge (↑ or ↓).
v_assign_continuous: Step {n}: an assignment (:=) is a stored action; use “on activation”, “on deactivation” or “on event”.
rep_p_event_action: “{g}”: on-event actions are exported as an ST assignment (the edge is lost).
rep_p_source: “{g}”: the source transition (no upstream step) is exported with no input connection; some tools reject it.
rep_p_sink: “{g}”: the sink transition (no downstream step) is exported with nothing after it; some tools reject it.
sync_help: Steps tested from another grafcet of the project (receptivities and action conditions).
trans_act_help: Executed when the transition fires; the optional condition is shown above the action.
rep_p_trans_action: “{g}”: actions linked to transition ({n}) are not exported.
a_jump_added: Jump added: pick its target in the properties.
a_pending_connect: Connect: pick the element to connect to (click, or arrows then Enter). Esc cancels.
a_pending_jump: Jump: pick the target (click, or arrows then Enter). Esc cancels.
a_pending_mergeEnds: Convergence: pick the other sequence end. Esc cancels.
a_pending_mergeStarts: Divergence: pick the other sequence start. Esc cancels.
a_pending_need_node: Pick a step or a transition.
a_pending_impossible: These two elements cannot be linked (incompatible types or places).
pending_connect: Connect to…: click the element to reach
pending_mergeEnds: Merge into a convergence: click the other sequence end
pending_mergeStarts: Merge into a divergence: click the other sequence start
tb_div_hint: Adds a divergence after the element: what follows becomes the first branch.
tb_conv_hint: Adds a convergence before the element: what precedes becomes the first branch; the second one is built upwards.
tb_jump_hint: Jump from the sequence end, to the initial step or the first possible element
tb_jump_to_hint: Jump from the sequence end to the element you click
tb_connect_hint: Connects this sequence end to an element: merges sequences, joins a convergence or a divergence, otherwise a jump
tb_merge_ends_hint: Merges two sequence ends into a convergence (OR after two transitions, AND after two steps)
tb_merge_starts_hint: Merges two sequence starts under a divergence (OR for two transitions, AND for two steps)
tb_free: Free elements (not attached to the selection)
or_hint_div: Choice: only one branch is crossed. The first transitions’ receptivities must be exclusive.
or_hint_conv: End of an alternative: each branch reaches what follows on its own.
and_hint_conv: Synchronisation: what follows waits for every branch to be done.
link_hint: Branches may come from different divergences: use “Connect to…” to add an existing one.
seq_empty_hint: Insert a step or a transition to build this branch (upwards or downwards).
key_div: OR / AND divergence after the cursor
key_conv: OR / AND convergence before the cursor
chk_end_used: a sequence end can be used only once (divergence, convergence or jump)
chk_start_used: a sequence start can be used only once
chk_div_or_base: an OR divergence follows a step
chk_div_and_base: an AND divergence follows a transition
chk_conv_or_end: an OR convergence branch ends with a transition
chk_conv_and_end: an AND convergence branch ends with a step
chk_conv_or_base: what follows an OR convergence starts with a step
chk_conv_and_base: what follows an AND convergence starts with a transition
chk_jump_from: a jump starts at the end of a non-empty sequence
chk_jump_kind: a jump links a step to a transition or the other way round
chk_cycle: the bars form a loop (use a jump to loop)
v_empty_seq: Empty slot (X) to fill in or remove.
rep_p_open_link: “{g}”: an open divergence or convergence is exported as is; check it in your tool.
